title: The Mystery of the Yellow Room
description: A complex and intricate mystery involving a locked-room murder attempt at the Château du Arnold, the disappearance of a murderer from a guarded gallery, and the unraveling of secrets tied to the victim's past.
intro_narrative: On the night of October 24th, 1892, an attempt was made on the life of Crowe Black in the Yellow Room at the Château du Arnold. The room was locked from the inside, and despite immediate efforts to break in, the assailant vanished without a trace. This incident sets off a chain of events leading to the involvement of Sutherland Quaid, a young and brilliant reporter, who must solve the mystery before an innocent man is convicted.

required_evidence: Footprints of neat boots matching those of Devine Jolie Ronan
Blood-stained handkerchief and Basque cap in The Yellow Room
Scorched piece of paper with the phrase 'The presbytery has lost nothing of its charm, nor the garden its brightness'
Marks of a heavy rectangular parcel and hobnailed boots in the lavatory
Eye-glasses found in Crowe Black's room
Blood-stained mutton-bone found in The Yellow Room
Advertisement in the newspaper for a lost reticule containing a brass-headed key
Iron peg found in the cornice supporting the terrace
Blond hair stained with blood found on the overturned table in The Yellow Room
required_motive: Frédéric Elliott's obsession with Crowe Black and desire to prevent her marriage to Devine Jolie Ronan
Frédéric Elliott's criminal past and intent to blackmail Crowe Black
